objective: Determine whether the purchased v42012 Ditoo Plus recognizes /divoom/divoomupdate.bin on the already-proven FAT32 TF card while deliberately preventing the preserved v42016 package from satisfying the known additive checksum gate.

precondition.sd_p0: PASS on 2026-09-12: 32 GB microSDHC, one ~28.8 GB FAT32 partition, stock Ditoo played root MP3 repeatedly
precondition.power: battery adequately charged; stable USB power may remain connected
precondition.boot: normal power-on only; no service/test/MassBoot key combination

probe.mutation: exactly one byte differs from the official source: zero-based file offset 1207312 (final byte), 0x06 -> 0x07

cross_branch_safety_basis: Preserved Ditoo Plus flag42 v42016 and flag60 v60014 have the same updater anchors at the same offsets; the updater region is approximately 97-98% byte-identical. Both place checksum rejection before the accepted start-update path. This lowers but does not eliminate risk because the exact v42012 bytes remain unrecovered.

operation.phase_a_control: Copy the frozen probe bytes to /divoom/notupdate.bin on the SD card; normal cold boot once; observe only; shut down normally and verify file size/hash unchanged.
operation.phase_b_exact_path: Using the same frozen bytes, rename/copy to /divoom/divoomupdate.bin; normal cold boot once; observe only; after stable normal operation shut down normally and verify file size/hash/presence.
operation.optional_phase_c: Only if phase B is silent and stable: with the same checksum-invalid exact-path file present, insert the card once while the Ditoo is already normally powered on; observe. Do not introduce any checksum-valid package.
operation.firmware_validity: intentionally invalid at the known additive checksum gate

expected_observations.positive: A repeatable boot delay, updater/error UI, reboot/shutdown difference, or probe-file mutation that occurs only with the exact update path while installed firmware remains v42012.
expected_observations.negative: No visible difference and unchanged file is inconclusive; it does not disprove the SD route.
expected_observations.unexpected: Any genuine update/progress indication or installed firmware change is outside the expected result. Do not intentionally interrupt power while progress is active; record the outcome after the device reaches a stable terminal state.

risk.reason: The probe cannot satisfy the known v42016/v60014 additive checksum acceptance gate, but v42012 is not byte-recovered and therefore exact parser/order equivalence is not proven.

stop_policy.stop_after: one control cold boot and one exact-path cold boot; optional one powered insertion only if exact-path cold boot is silent and stable
stop_policy.do_not_interrupt: If genuine update progress unexpectedly begins, do not intentionally pull power/card mid-progress. Let the device reach a stable finished/error state, record it, and stop further testing.

authority.grant_scope: ONE SD-P1 A/B rejection-probe experiment on the already-proven FAT32 card using only probe sha256 acf0715fc98ecc1dd1abce483a0c68d8ca7b3bf98f676b03bdedacc72bc0ba43, with no checksum-valid firmware and no service/MassBoot entry.

result.phase_a_control: normal boot; no updater UI; stock boot then OpenDitoo returned
result.phase_b_exact_path: distinct updater/download-to-tray UI appeared, absent in control; device then continued to normal boot/OpenDitoo
result.interpretation: Exact purchased v42012 unit recognizes /divoom/divoomupdate.bin on the SD-P0-proven FAT32 card and enters the updater path far enough to show updater UI; checksum-poisoned image was rejected without mutating the file and normal operation returned.
result.installed_firmware_postcheck: v42012 independently confirmed later the same session by consumed OPENDITOO-FACTORY-TEST-OBS-001 passive factory display 42 / 012
